colors.rule: Reference tokens by name (Tailwind utilities such as bg-spring, or var(--spring) inside SVG and gradients). Never invent a new color value.

content.currency: currency unit word after the number

description: Bahar design-language preset for agents and shadcn-style tooling. Token names only; values live in the Bahar global stylesheet. Apply this preset instead of any foreign kit default.

heading: Arad
Vazirmatn
fonts.latinNote: Manrope is approved for Latin, Cyrillic, and Greek text only. Persian and Arabic text always use Vazirmatn and Arad.

forbidden.rule: No new color values, no foreign fonts, no physical side utilities, no letter-split Persian animation, no Motion+ paid features, no Pro components, no paid Persian templates, no edits to school site templates, language packs, country packs, or module definitions.

motion.page: soft fade with a small start-side slide
motion.reducedMotion: static final state, no looping motion
motion.splitText: word level only for Persian text; never split letters

name: bahar-preset

rtl.motion: Directional motion mirrors by document direction: entering from the start side comes from the inline-start edge.
rtl.rule: Logical utilities only. Never use physical side utilities.

sizes.note: Compact variants below 44 (small button, search pill) are not primary touch targets.

spacing.grids: 3 or 4 columns on large screens, 2 on medium, 1 on small
spacing.sections: generous vertical rhythm; cards breathe, no dense packing
